validation_results.failure: The Vermilion top-up used fixed dialogue pulses after the 30-Ball purchase and failed to reach the Super Potion quantity selector under this schedule.

diagnosis: The capture reserve itself was purchased correctly, but the following Mart transaction assumed a fixed number of receipt-dialogue pulses. Timing variation left a different menu phase active, so the chapter could not top one surviving Super Potion up to two.
repair_direction: Observe the live priced-list coordinates, select the source-pinned Super Potion entry by absolute index, verify its item identity and quantity selector, and finish only when the exact bag target is observed.
